title: Ježica roundabout protest over safety and state action after an attack on a farmer
protester_identity: Local residents and civic-initiative supporters; attendees included people from Šentjernej.

occurrence.summary: Three contemporaneous article bodies describe one executed protest on the Ježica roundabout on 16 July, not three gatherings.

threshold.summary: Dnevnik reports approx. 100; N1 and a separate Dnevnik report cite approx. 300 based on Ljubljana police estimates. Conflicting numbers, but both exceed 50.

state_target.summary: N1 says organizers sent demands to government, ministries, MPs and Ljubljana municipality seeking safety, equality before law and action.

demands.summary: General public-order/safety and law-enforcement measures; category political_behavior_process. Some posters were reused from earlier events and are not assumed to be organizers’ current demands.

protester_violence.summary: No report of violence by protesters; absence is not coded as no_explicit.

state_response.summary: Police presence/traffic management is reported, but a response to the demands is not established. All response dimensions remain unknown.

end_date.summary: N1 reports roughly one-hour traffic interruption but no precise end time. End date remains unknown.

open_questions: Independent reviewer should resolve how the conflicting police-attributed attendance estimates are presented; both exceed 50.
No subsequent response to the written demands is documented in these articles.
Check relevant manual coding caveats for a gathering whose organizers’ safety demands arose in an ethnically charged context; do not recast the event or infer demands from all political speeches.
